# Phosphor icon assets

- Package: `@phosphor-icons/web`
- Version: `2.1.2`
- License: MIT; see `LICENSE`
- Source: <https://github.com/phosphor-icons/web>
- Bundled weights: Regular and Fill

The local CSS exposes only glyphs used by tripto.to. Regular is the default UI weight. Fill is reserved for selected/current states. Custom SVG is limited to weather, destination, and approved branded illustrations.
